description: A Minecraft  mod where mobs dynamically scale in size and step height based on their health.

mods.name: Health-Based Mob Scaling
mods.description: Dynamically scales mob size and step height based on their current health

releases.notes: # 🧬 Health Based Mob Scaling – v1.0 ## 🟢 Initial Release Introducing **Health Based Mob Scaling**, a Fabric mod that dynamically adjusts mob size and step height based on their health. --- ## ✨ Features - 📈 Mobs grow larger as their health increases - 🦶 Step height scales with mob size - ⚙️ Fully automatic system (no commands required) - 👥 Only affects mobs near players --- ## ⚙️ Mechanics - **Scale = Health × 0.25** - **Step Height = Health × 0.125** This creates a natural gameplay effect: - Strong mobs become bigger and more dominant - Weak mobs shrink, making combat more intuitive --- ## 🚀 Performance - Updates every **20 ticks (1 second)** - Only processes mobs within **128 blocks of players** - Designed for smooth performance in survival worlds --- ## 🛠️ Technical Details - Built using Fabric API - Uses Minecraft’s attribute system - Includes safety checks for compatibility --- ## 📦 Requirements - Minecraft **1.21.11** - Fabric Loader - Fabric API --- ## 📥 Installation 1. Install Fabric Loader 2. Download and install Fabric API 3. Place the mod `.jar` file into your `mods` folder 4. Launch the game --- ## 🔮 Future Plans - Config file for customizable scaling - Smooth size transition effects - Per-mob scaling settings --- ## ⭐ Support If you like the mod, consider starring the repository and sharing feedback!
